verdict.rationale: Runtime portability is a fair question for an edge and serverless hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack never documents that Netlify functions or edge code use standard, portable runtime APIs that run unmodified on other edge platforms. The storage example shown, `getStore("file-uploads")`, is a Netlify-specific Blobs API. The mentioned "programmatic Cache API" is never described as standards-based or portable, so it cannot be credited.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
